f1.quote: The authors developed a spray-drying/thermal decomposition-reduction (SD-TDR) synthesis of noble-metal high-entropy-alloy three-dimensional nanoframeworks (HEA-3DNFs).

f3.quote: Precursors were then heated in H2 at 3°C/min to 300°C for 30 min and cooled at 5°–10°C/min.
